title: implement-frontend-feature input
description: ENFORCED — the engine validates this ASSEMBLED stage input against this schema BEFORE the stage runs (engine/validation.py validate_stage_input; fail-closed, engine/config/runtime-binding.yaml input_validation: enforce). Shape below is the POST-adapter payload delivered at stage frontend-implement.

api_contracts.description: Shape: designing-tech-lead-handoff schemas/output.json#/properties/api_contracts. Verbatim shape of templates/tech-lead-contracts.md embedded schema. These are the cross-component INTERFACE contracts (the architecture's connective tissue), NOT per-service endpoint specs. payload_shape is intentionally open (free-form JSON-Schema-ish object per the template).

component_map.description: Shape: designing-tech-lead-handoff schemas/output.json#/properties/component_map. Verbatim shape of templates/tech-lead-components.md embedded schema. dependencies[] MUST resolve to api_contracts.contracts[].contract_name (referential integrity enforced at runtime by tests/assertions/contract-completeness.md — not expressible in draft-07).

idempotency_key.description: engine-injected: the workflow's single idempotency key, injected into every stage payload.

upstream_artifacts.description: engine-injected: map of producer stage id to its artifact path relative to this stage's dir.

loop_back_feedback.description: engine-injected (conditional): reviewer findings threaded into a re-run after a loop_back.

maturity_level.description: UX pack maturity. 3 = implementation-ready; 2 = BA-derived draft — proceed WITH a P2 advisory uncertainty flag (zero P1 findings still required).

p1_findings.description: Must be empty: any P1 UX finding blocks implementation.
